title: Zones Plus
description: Custom player zones with upgrades, durability, holograms and destruction mechanics.
body:
# 🏰 Zones Plus

**Create, upgrade, defend and conquer territories on your server.**

Zones Plus is a territory management plugin that allows players to create their own zones, upgrade them, expand their protection radius and fight for control over territories.

_**- RUSSIAN LANGUAGE SUPPORT ONLY FOR NOW**_

✨ Features
🏷️ Create Your Own Zone

Create a personal zone and give it a unique name.

**⬆️ Upgrade System**

Collect resources and upgrade your zone to unlock stronger territory levels.

Each upgrade increases your zone radius:


```
* Level 1 — 15 blocks
* Level 2 — 20 blocks
* Level 3 — 40 blocks
* Level 4 — 70 blocks
```


**❤️ Zone Health**

Every zone has its own durability.

Players can attack enemy zones and reduce their health until the zone is completely destroyed.

**🎮 Commands**

```
/zones - open menu
/zones list - all zones
/zones delete <Your Zone> or /zones del <Your Zone>
```
